notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
I've added a setting to switch the aspect ratio between wide and standard. You can find this setting both in the configuration phase at the beginning of the game (the little gear icon on the left) and in the OS toolbar (on the settings page). This should allow players with very large or very small monitors to have a normal gaming experience, even though the game was designed using the classic 16:9 aspect ratio.

[b]CHANGELOG:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added the aspect ratio setting to the OS toolbar.
[*] Added the aspect ratio setting to the initial OS configuration screen.
[/list]

Follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/sykoldgames]Twitter[/url] for more updates!

notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The issue where certain users couldn't progress through the game should have been resolved. If you encounter any other bugs, please inform me, and I'll promptly address them. Additionally, please be aware that your save file will be overwritten due to modifications in the save encryption type. I apologize for any inconvenience caused and extend my thanks to everyone playing my game :)

CHANGELOG:

[list]
[*] Fixed a game-breaking bug where a certain message wouldn't arrive.
[*] Fixed an issue where an icon wouldn't be deactivated.
[*] Fixed a save point loading wrong data.
[*] Changed save encryption type.
[*] Minor code refactoring.
[/list]
